negative.name: threshold-duplicate-control-key
negative.reason: Thresholds count distinct keys: one key listed twice cannot meet a 2-of-3 nextThreshold.

negative.name: pre-rotation-forged-update
negative.reason: Correctly signed by a key whose hash the previous event did not commit to in `next`; pre-rotation, not the signature, rejects it.

negative.name: next-threshold-zero
negative.reason: nextThreshold must be at least 1 and a majority of `next`.

negative.name: next-threshold-minority
negative.reason: nextThreshold 1 of 2 is not a majority of `next`.

negative.name: collective-threshold-zero
negative.reason: A collective's threshold must be at least 1.

negative.name: collective-threshold-minority
negative.reason: Threshold 1 of 3 is not a majority, so two disjoint members could each sign conflicting events.

negative.name: collective-genesis-missing-founder
negative.reason: Every founding member must sign the genesis.

negative.name: event-after-retire
negative.reason: No event may follow a Retire, for collectives as for key-controlled minds.

negative.name: merge-reserved
negative.reason: Merge is reserved; a verifier of this revision rejects a log containing it.

negative.name: recovery-reserved
negative.reason: `recovery` is a reserved member name; a verifier of this revision rejects an event containing it.

negative.name: wrong-proof-purpose
negative.reason: An Intent needs an assertionMethod proof; an authentication proof does not count.
